additions.name: Bell Park
additions.note: Court exists but is not mapped in OpenStreetMap. Location from the 2016 CPD tennis points for this park.

additions.name: McFetridge Sports Center (indoor)
additions.note: Six indoor courts (Park District page). Court time is booked online up to 6 days ahead and paid at booking (McFetridge site). Located at the McFetridge building; the 4 outdoor courts are listed as California Park.

corrections.note: Park page: "Tennis court lights will be on an hour before dusk." Court hours Monday–Sunday 7:00 am–9:00 pm.

corrections.name: Diversey Tennis Center
corrections.note: Diversey Tennis Center, run by the Lincoln Park Tennis Association: Chicago's public clay courts at the east end of Diversey Parkway. $28 an hour, booked online up to 7 days ahead; walk-ins welcome.
